description: This file contains the implementation of enterprise-specific callback control logic for the litellm framework, including methods to check if callbacks are dynamically disabled based on headers or request parameters, and to retrieve disabled callback configurations.

classes.name: EnterpriseCallbackControls
classes.description: A class providing static methods to control and check the enablement status of callbacks in an enterprise environment, including dynamic disabling checks based on headers and request parameters.

methods.name: bool is_callback_disabled_dynamically( callback: litellm.CALLBACK_TYPES, litellm_params: dict, standard_callback_dynamic_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams )
methods.description: Determines if a callback is dynamically disabled based on headers or callback registration, considering user permissions and callback type.

methods.name: Optional[List[str]] get_disabled_callbacks(litellm_params: dict, standard_callback_dynamic_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams)
methods.description: Retrieves the list of disabled callbacks from request headers or request parameters.

methods.name: _should_allow_dynamic_callback_disabling()
methods.description: Checks whether dynamic callback disabling is allowed, depending on admin settings, user permissions, and enterprise features.

ctags.name: is_callback_disabled_dynamically
ctags.signature: ( callback: litellm.CALLBACK_TYPES, litellm_params: dict, standard_callback_dynamic_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams )
